The '''Zipthar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Zipthar hexa-crystal]]s.<ref name="It's a Gambler's Life">{{JournalCite|4|It's a Gambler's Life}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Zipthar hexa-crystal]]s|system=Zipthar [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Zipthar system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-2.<ref name="TEA" />
